Hope scores over agony...

September 30, 2005

I am tired of all the nonsense in life! But then who isn’t? Moreover I always wanted to be different. Maybe this is my chance! :-)

[….Thinking….]

I hate my optimism sometimes.. if it wasn’t for that, I wouldn’t have made it this far! Gee.. what a waste of “all the rotting days I had to face”.

New additions to music fav::

  • Greenday - Wake me when september ends
  • Third Eye Blind - Forgetting Myself
  • Seether - Remedy
  • System of a down - B.Y.O.B

Good music keeps it going. So three cheers to good music..
